item.unicode: San Diego Beach Yoga Hiking Tour
item.description:
#Explore Torrey Pines & Discover Yoga Bliss on The Beach

Embark on a deeply restorative hiking journey into the beauty and powerful energy of Torrey Pines with tranquil yoga on the beach. 

Release worldly stress, gain peace of mind and connect with the magic of the Pacific Ocean.
					
You'll work with a professional Yoga Teacher & Guide as you journey mindfully down a serene trail with sweeping views of the Ocean.  Unplug, and learn about the land as you tune in to the peace found only in nature.  

Upon reaching the pristine beach, you'll enjoy a blissful yoga, breath work and meditation session in sand.

**Ready to Book? Pick your desired date & time from the calendar and reserve your spot today!**

##Session Includes:
- 3hr Custom, Private Tour with an Experienced Teacher
- Perfect Balance of Yoga & Hiking
- Restorative Hatha Yoga on the beach!
- Soul-Charging Breath-Work
- Deep Guided Meditation
- Complimentary Yoga Mat/Blanket Rentals

##Hike Length & Difficulty
- 4 Mile Hike
- Gentle, Beautiful Trail
- All Levels Welcome

##What to Bring
- Water Bottle
- Comfy Clothes
- Good Shoes

##About Your Hosts
Vita Pura Yoga has grown from a humble living room yoga studio to a top yoga retreat and wellness company (TripAdvisor, 2022/23). Their unique combination of traditional yoga science with soulful hiking has helped thousands of students blossom and grow. Now home to a team teachers, healers and guides, they deliver specular results to students every day. If you're looking for a special spiritual experience in San Diego, you've found it.

##How It Works
We make this experience as easy as possible.  Just meet your teacher at the trailhead. Your teacher will have yoga mats ready to lend for the adventure.

##Is This Good For Groups?
This is perfect for groups of all sizes, from solo travelers to groups of 15+.  Enjoy a custom experience designed to meet your groups level, goals and needs with expert attention from our amazing teachers.

##Do I Need Past Yoga or Hiking Experience?
All ages and levels are welcome, no experience required - just an open mind and desire to grow. Your teacher will customize the session based on your unique needs and level.

##What Kind of Yoga Is This?
We teach authentic, traditional Hatha yoga science.  The practice is true to its holistic Eastern roots as apposed to Western "fitness yoga".  You'll learn to move energy within the body through invigorating Pranayama (Breath Work) alongside restorative asana postures and deep meditation.  In doing so, you'll be able to release stress, trauma and old wounds, creating space for healing.

##What Do Our Clients Say?
- "Our first experience with yoga hiking! I am an average yogi, my husband has no experience with yoga at all, and neither of us are super experienced hikers. **I am so glad I booked this, it was the highlight of our trip!**"
-Chrissy

- "**I had a truly transformational and peaceful experience**...The hike was beautiful. My guide led me to some amazing Breath-Work where I embodied a sense of inner peace that I have a never experienced."
-Sherri

- "We had the best time on our hike with Nichole! She was so easy to connect with and taught us a ton. Our yoga experience was incredible - the views were 10/10 as well as our session. **Can’t recommend this experience enough!!**"
-Spencer

- "The overall experience was amazing on all fronts. Reservation process was simple and communication was excellent. Reminders and meeting point GPS was provided prior to scheduled event...**Hike was gorgeous and yoga was perfect.** This yoga and hiking event was the focal point of our trip for my wife's 50th birthday."
-Charlie

- "Where do I start? **I booked this tour with some girlfriends and we had an amazing experience.** Our instructor’s name was Minyan...He provided us with information about the city, the park, the wildlife, the plants and gave us recommendations to check out. And to top it all off, he was an excellent yoga instructor. He provided modifications and a better understanding of yoga."
-Denisse

**Don't miss this once in a lifetime experience. Create a memory that won't just leave you charged, it'll leave you transformed.**
item.booking_notes:
#Congratulations, Your Yoga Hike is Booked!  
Take a deep breath and feel excited.  You've taken a powerful step.  This is not just a simple tour, it is a transformational healing experience.

Our yoga hiking sessions are designed to provide you with complete rejuvenation, harnessing the beauty and nourishing energy of Torrey Pines and the Pacific Ocean with a powerful hiking and yoga practice on the beach.

##About the Hike##

The hiking portion of this experience is meant to be gentle, with elements of mindfulness and Forest Bathing incorporated to bring you fully into the present.  

The trail is well maintained and roughly 4 miles in length, with a gradual descent to the beach and eventual climb back up the trail.  

**There are many steps leading down and the sandstone can be slick at times.**

##About Your Beach Yoga Session##

Your teacher will provide yoga mats/blankets for you to carry along the trail. Your yoga class occurs once you reach the sandy ocean shoreline.

This yoga practice is restorative and holistic, fusing together a Breath Work and Asana practice under the careful guidance of a highly trained teacher.  

If you are coming from a Western yoga background, it is important to note that this is a traditional, more Eastern yoga experience.  Expect to slow things down, go deep within and move some energy!

**This experience is about dissolving the ego, gaining presence and then moving forward in life with fresh new energy.**

##What to do Next##
- 1) Take a moment to set your intention and write it down.  Ask yourself, "in what ways would I like to grow, gain or release from this experience?"  There is no right or wrong answer.  Just put it into words and save it for later.

- 2) Add your appointment to your personal calendar so you don't miss it!

- 3) Share our yoga hiking page with your group (if applicable) so that they know what to expect.

##What to Bring:##
- Comfy Clothes
- Good Shoes w/ Traction
- **Water Bottle (Most Important!)**
- Sun Glasses (you may be facing the setting sun)
- Sun Protection (if needed)
- A Light Snack (if needed)

**We'll provide you with complementary yoga mat/blankets for the day.**

##Safety First##
Your safety is always our #1 priority during this experience. While yoga hiking is generally considered to be very safe, please be aware that there are some inherent risks practicing yoga outdoors. Use caution and always stay on the trail.

##Weather##
San Diego is known for its year round beautiful weather. While this is mostly true, there are still times of intense heat during the Summer, and chilly days during the winter.

**Please prepare with plenty of water, warmth or sun protection if needed.**

##Wild Animals##
Torrey Pines has a host of amazing local wildlife that live in the park. Please be aware that you may come across some them during your hiking experience. 

**While it is rare, please be mindful of rattlesnake encounters along the trail and do not approach them if spotted.**

##Trail Etiquette##
- Please stay on the trail at all times.  
- Practice mindfulness, awareness and safety at all times.
- Pack it in, pack it out and leave no trace.

##Cell Phone Usage##
While we encourage a mostly device free experience, taking pictures is of course welcome.  Please save your social media posts and shares for after the session however, and allow yourself to be fully present for the experience. 

##Gratuities##
It is customary to tip your teacher/guide if you have enjoyed your experience with us. Typical tips and gratuities range between 15 and 25 percent, depending on how you enjoyed and were impacted by your experience. Our teachers very much appreciate your generosity and are there to ensure you have the most incredible time with us possible.

##Questions/Contact##
We're here to help you in preparing for this experience in every way we can. If you have a question that comes up before your yoga hike, please reach out to us via email or simply give us a call/text.  We'll normally get back to you within 24hrs at most.  

**Thank You & Namaste!**
**Vita Pura Yoga**
**928-707-2408**
item.cancellation_notes:
#Flexible Cancellation Policy:
Life is unpredictable, we know. If something comes up and you must cancel your yoga hiking session we are happy to provide a full deposit refund so long as you let us know 14 days prior to the start date.

If a cancellation is made within 13 days of the tour start date, your deposit will be allowed to stay on file as credit towards rescheduling another session with us in the future.

Any cancellations made within 48hrs of the start date are non-refundable and subject to being charged full price.

start_location.name: Torry Pines State Natural Preserve
start_location.note:
Take Torrey Pines Rd directly to the State Park. The Park entrance is on beach level.

Your yoga hiking tour is paid for, but there is a $10 entrance fee to gain access to the park.

**Once inside, please park at the Upper Parking Lot (near old The Lodge) where you will meet your teacher.**

**Torrey Pines can get very crowded - especially on weekends - and there is often a line at the gate. We recommend arriving a minimum of 15 minutes early to ensure parking.**
